tests.name: Survivorship bias
tests.detail: Universe includes possibly-delisted symbols flagged in audit. Full CRSP-based survivorship correction not available. Bias risk: MODERATE.

tests.name: Delisted-security omission
tests.detail: Some delisted securities may not have data in Yahoo Finance. flagged in delisted_audit.

tests.name: Future constituent leakage
tests.detail: No future constituents used. All symbols have historical data from their first available date.

tests.name: Historical universe reconstruction error
tests.detail: Universe constructed from DS-EXP-100 (pre-existing) + additional symbols. No reconstruction of historical constituents attempted.

tests.name: Ticker mapping error
tests.detail: Static GICS mapping applied. No ticker changes detected in source data. Limitation: mapping is approximate for some symbols.

tests.name: Corporate-action leakage
tests.detail: Corporate actions detected via large price moves and volume spikes. Flagged in corporate_action_audit. No forward-looking adjustment.

tests.name: Dividend adjustment error
tests.detail: Adjusted close used for label computation (returns). Raw close used for feature stability. No dividend-specific adjustment attempted.

tests.name: Split adjustment error
tests.detail: Yahoo Finance adjusted close incorporates split adjustments. Large price moves flagged for manual review.

tests.name: Future macro publication leakage
tests.detail: All macro series classified as PIT_NATIVE or PIT_SAFE_WITH_LAG. CPI uses 45-day lag for safety.

tests.name: CPI revision leakage
tests.detail: CPI classified as PIT_SAFE_WITH_LAG. Vintage snapshots not available; 45-day lag provides safety margin.

tests.name: FEDFUNDS timing error
tests.detail: FEDFUNDS published same day, classified PIT_NATIVE. Monthly data forward-filled to daily.

tests.name: VIX timestamp error
tests.detail: VIXCLS is end-of-day closing value. Used as PIT_NATIVE with same-day availability.

tests.name: Credit spread timing error
tests.detail: BAA10Y is daily yield observation. No timing issue.

tests.name: T10YIE timing error
tests.detail: T10YIE is daily market-based measure. No timing issue.

tests.name: Future forward-fill
tests.detail: No forward-fill of future data performed. Monthly series forward-filled using only past data.

tests.name: Centered rolling transformation
tests.detail: No rolling transformations applied in this phase. Only raw data and audit statistics computed.

tests.name: Timezone mismatch
tests.detail: All price data is daily (no intraday timezone issues). FRED data is daily/monthly with no timezone ambiguity.

tests.name: Weekend alignment error
tests.detail: Price data from Yahoo Finance is trading-day only. FRED data aligned to business days.

tests.name: Holiday alignment error
tests.detail: No holiday alignment issues detected. Trading-day data naturally excludes holidays.

tests.name: Duplicate rows
tests.detail: 0 duplicate rows detected and removed.

tests.name: Duplicate securities
tests.detail: No duplicate symbols in final universe.

tests.name: Malformed observations
tests.detail: 0 impossible OHLC observations detected.

tests.name: Impossible prices
tests.detail: 0 zero/negative price observations detected.

tests.name: Stale data
tests.detail: No stale data detected. All observations are from their expected time periods.

tests.name: Hidden missing values
tests.detail: 0 missing values across OHLCV columns.

tests.name: Fake effective sample size
tests.detail: ESS computed with measured autocorrelation and cross-sectional correlation. Not inflated.

tests.name: Sequence overlap inflation
tests.detail: Sequence overlap explicitly computed. Effective independent sequences = raw / overlap_ratio.

tests.name: Cross-sectional correlation inflation
tests.detail: Measured pairwise correlation applied to ESS correction. Not assumed zero.

tests.name: Current-constituent-only universe
tests.detail: Universe includes possibly-delisted symbols. Full survivorship correction requires CRSP data.

tests.name: Protected OOS access
tests.detail: No OOS data accessed in this phase. Only historical development data and FRED macro data used.

tests.name: Confirmatory execution
tests.detail: No confirmatory tests executed. This is a data acquisition phase only.

tests.name: Registration modification
tests.detail: No registrations modified. Branch registry and feature system registry untouched.

tests.name: Historical artifact modification
tests.detail: No historical artifacts modified. All existing benchmarks preserved.

tests.name: Simulated data substitution
tests.detail: All data is real market data from Yahoo Finance and FRED. No synthetic data used.

tests.name: Dataset manifest mismatch
tests.detail: V2 manifest generated and digest computed. Cross-verified with actual data properties.

tests.name: Dataset digest mismatch
tests.detail: Digest computed from universe, rows, dates, and macro series. Deterministic.

tests.name: Silent preprocessing transformation
tests.detail: No preprocessing transformations applied. Only raw data loading and validation.

tests.name: Unsupported data source substitution
tests.detail: All data from documented sources (Yahoo Finance, FRED). No unauthorized substitutions.
